evidence: Modifies block and undo file storage pruning logic in `src/node/blockstorage.cpp` and `src/node/blockstorage.h`.
rationale: Replaces an O(M * N) loop over the block index with a single batched pass, eliminating long node freezes while holding `cs_main`. On full chain pruning, startup time dropped from 75.1s to 14.7ms on x86_64 (~5,100x) and from 606.0s to 26.3ms on Raspberry Pi 5 (>3,500x).
